color.note: Corporate blues lead; Gaudí glaze colours (turquoise, terracotta, saffron, olive, majolica, ceramic) support. Blue hexes are PLACEHOLDERS until the corporate blues are confirmed; secondary colours need corporate brand approval before external use.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Main corporate dark blue (placeholder). Logo, wordmark, hero and header grounds. The colour people should remember MOSAIC by.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: Large brand fields: header bands, cover blocks. Darker than the ground in the dark theme so it never disappears.

tokens.name: grout
tokens.usage: The gaps between shards on dark grounds. Never used for text.

tokens.name: ground-shard
tokens.usage: Background shards on navy. Keep within ±3% lightness of brand-navy so text on top stays readable.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Highlight panels such as the Retrofit panel. ink and heading pass 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings, step titles and bold leads, on surface or surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface or surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, footers, secondary lines. Passes 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Section labels, check icons, roadmap badges, links. 5:1 on white; on navy use the dark value.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines. Decorative only: not for controls that need 3:1.

tokens.name: shard-eps
tokens.usage: Subsystem colour in data-driven mosaics: EPS (power, solar arrays).

tokens.name: shard-aocs
tokens.usage: Subsystem colour: AOCS.

tokens.name: shard-obdh
tokens.usage: Subsystem colour: OBDH.

tokens.name: shard-tcs
tokens.usage: Subsystem colour: TCS (thermal).

tokens.name: shard-prop
tokens.usage: Subsystem colour: propulsion.

tokens.name: shard-comms
tokens.usage: Subsystem colour: communications (the lightest shard; also the logo's dish).

tokens.name: shard-payload
tokens.usage: Subsystem colour: payload.

tokens.name: turquoise
tokens.usage: Secondary. Telemetry and time series: borders, icons, chart series. Glaze colour from Park Güell's trencadís.

tokens.name: turquoise-tint
tokens.usage: Background of telemetry areas and chips.

tokens.name: turquoise-text
tokens.usage: Turquoise text: 7:1 on turquoise-tint, passes on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Secondary. Documents and highlights: borders, icons, chart series. Not for text on white (4.0:1).

tokens.name: terracotta-tint
tokens.usage: Background of document areas and highlight chips.

tokens.name: terracotta-text
tokens.usage: Terracotta text: 5.7:1 on white, passes on terracotta-tint.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Accent. AI proposals awaiting review, warnings, attention. Fills and icons only; never text on white (1.8:1).

tokens.name: saffron-tint
tokens.usage: Background of AI-proposed items and warning banners.

tokens.name: saffron-text
tokens.usage: Text on saffron-tint and saffron-coloured labels.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Status only: success, approved. Always with an icon or label: indistinguishable from terracotta and majolica for some colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: olive-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success banners and approved items.

tokens.name: olive-text
tokens.usage: Success text: 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: majolica
tokens.usage: Status only: errors and rejected proposals. Never decorative. Always with an icon or label.

tokens.name: majolica-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and rejected items.

tokens.name: majolica-text
tokens.usage: Error text on white or majolica-tint.

tokens.name: ceramic
tokens.usage: Optional warm background for marketing pieces and covers. App screens stay on surface.

tokens.name: tessera
tokens.usage: MOSAIC Tessera identity: the customer’s half of the Tessera mark and the word “Tessera” in lockups on white. A sub-brand colour, not a data category.

tokens.name: tessera-bright
tokens.usage: MOSAIC Tessera identity on navy: the customer’s half of the mark and the word “Tessera” on dark grounds.

tokens.name: tessera-ours-bright
tokens.usage: Our half of the Tessera mark on navy grounds (on white it is brand-navy).

tokens.name: data-reference
tokens.usage: Category: reference data (SRDB, tables, flight procedures, code). Diagrams, charts, chips.

tokens.name: data-telemetry
tokens.usage: Category: telemetry and time series.

tokens.name: data-documents
tokens.usage: Category: documents and annotations.

tokens.name: data-pattern
tokens.usage: Category: the pattern (schema and semantics).

tokens.name: ai-proposal
tokens.usage: Anything AI proposed that an engineer has not yet approved.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational states.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success and approved states, with a check icon.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and pending review, with a warning icon.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Errors and rejected states, with an error icon.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name, always in capitals, in brand-navy or white. Scale freely; keep the 3px tracking proportional (0.04em).

styles.name: category
styles.usage: The category line under the wordmark, in accent (or shard-tcs on navy).

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Instead of building the mission from a model, we build the model from the mission’s existing data.
styles.usage: The definition line and other one-sentence statements.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: An MBSE view of every mission, assembled with AI from the data we already have.
styles.usage: The tagline, on navy in ink-dark (#E6EEF8).

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section labels, set in UPPERCASE, in accent.

styles.name: body-print
styles.sample: Click any parameter to see its packet, calibration, limits, procedures and telemetry.
styles.usage: Body text in printed A4 pieces (never below 12px).

styles.name: body-screen
styles.sample: Structured data is linked by rules, exactly. AI proposes the remaining links; engineers approve them.
styles.usage: Body text on screens and slides.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Each shard is one telemetry parameter, coloured by subsystem.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: title to description.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to text, list items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding (vertical), gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps between sections in a column.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gutter between columns.

tokens.name: margin-print
tokens.usage: Side margin on A4 pieces (≈12.7 mm).

tokens.name: safe-edge
tokens.usage: Minimum clear space from any trimmed edge.

tokens.name: grout-print
tokens.usage: Gap between shards in print-size artwork and dividers.

tokens.name: grout-hero
tokens.usage: Gap between shards in 1920-wide hero artwork.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Shards and tiles: never rounded, always irregular polygons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels around text.
